heading: The Marginarium: how it's made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns photos into paint-by-number templates on-device; its Marginarium chapters tell how Paul builds it with AI agents.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter keeps each story short and exact, and the full stories wait for the app, where they belong.
avoid: Avoid a mascot banner or emoji above the title, which would blur the README's cool, exact first impression.
